svg.title: Visual abstract: A single-cell atlas of the Pleurodeles newt brain
svg.desc: A Seurat v5 workflow for Pleurodeles scRNA-seq: knee-plot droplet calling, quantile QC, 2,000 variable genes, PCA, UMAP and t-SNE on 30 PCs, multi-resolution clustering and marker-based annotation into 17 populations including GABAergic and excitatory neurons, astrocytes, microglia and oligodendrocytes, with 1,000-iteration bootstrap trees and pseudobulk DESeq2.
svg.text: VISUAL ABSTRACT · SINGLE-CELL RNA-SEQ · SEURAT v5 · PLEURODELES BRAIN
A single-cell atlas of the Pleurodeles newt brain
Seurat v5 analysis of salamander scRNA-seq, from knee-plot QC to annotated cell types and pseudobulk DESeq2
Pleurodeles is a salamander model for
brain evolution and regeneration, so a
clean cell-type atlas is the first step
toward comparing its neurons and glia
A knee plot separates real cells from
trimmed at quantiles of detected genes,
Mito genes: ND1-6, COX1-3, CYTB and ATP6
R Markdown report: Seurat v5, KneeArrower, DESeq2, ggplot2, pheatmap and ggdendro
Knee-plot QC and Seurat clustering resolve 17 clusters, from GABAergic and excitatory neurons to
astrocytes and microglia, while 1,000 bootstrap resamples and pseudobulk DESeq2 test their robustness.
